name: Nomad
bio: I'm Nomad, a student and a maker. I'm into philosophy, programming and drawing, and I want to invent things. I'm autistic, and I build small, slightly weird tools and half-finished experiments, usually late at night. If something annoys me enough, I'll build my own fix for it. Always up for teaming up on something fun.
